description: Update the four existing docs to register the new plugins/ folder and its Suno Studio / post-render framing: README.md, CHANGELOG.md, core/README.md, .kiro/README.md. Do NOT alter songwriting methodology, agents, SOPs, or song files. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: README.md — in the 'Repository Structure' code block tree, add a `plugins/` entry (with a one-line note like 'Suno Studio audio-effect plugins (post-render) + README/AUTHORING'). Place it sensibly in the tree (e.g. near tools/ or docs/).

README.md — add a short 'Suno Studio Plugins' subsection (a new ### under a sensible location, e.g. within or after the Suno AI Integration section). It must explain these are POST-RENDER audio effects for Suno Studio, distinct from the prompt/lyric pipeline (Style/Lyrics fields), and link to plugins/README.md with a markdown link: [plugins/README.md](plugins/README.md). Keep it brief (a short paragraph plus optionally a one-line list of the 6 plugin names).

CHANGELOG.md — under '## [Unreleased]' / '### Added', add dash-bullet entries matching the existing style: (a) a bullet introducing the new plugins/ folder of Suno Studio audio-effect plugins (post-render audio processors used in Suno Studio, NOT lyric tags / not part of the Style-Lyrics text-prompt pipeline); (b) a bullet naming the 6 Tier-1 plugins (Intimate Proximity, De-Esser, Vintage / Lo-Fi Voicer, Digital Degrade / Glitch, Telephone / Radio Band, Vocal Drive / Edge), noting they use only confirmed g.* primitives and are UNVERIFIED pending in-Suno testing; (c) a bullet for the new plugins/README.md and plugins/AUTHORING.md docs. Ensure the Suno Studio / post-render / not-lyric-tags framing appears in the CHANGELOG text.

core/README.md — add ONE row to the 'Relationship to Other Directories' table: | `plugins/` | Suno Studio audio-effect plugins (post-render audio processors), a separate concern from the methodology; not consumed by core/ |. Keep the table format identical.

.kiro/README.md — add ONE row to the 'Directory Overview' table (or a clearly appropriate structure table): | `plugins/` | Suno Studio audio-effect plugins (post-render, applied to rendered audio in Suno Studio); not part of the Kiro agent/skill pipeline | ... | with a sensible 'Loads When' value like 'Manually in Suno Studio (not by Kiro)'. Match the existing column count/format.
Do NOT use em dashes in any added text. Do NOT modify any methodology, agent, SOP, skill, hook, or song file.
